notes: Times are measured on the client. They include network delay and queue wait.
TTFT is the arrival of the first non-empty content chunk, not the end of the request.
TPOT uses API completion_tokens. Inter-chunk gaps are recorded separately because one SSE event can carry more than one token.
This run uses Ollama. It checks the client and the result schema on Apple Silicon. It is a GGUF comparison, and the vLLM NVIDIA baseline remains unmeasured.
Each request starts with a random tag, so the server cannot reuse a cached prompt prefix.
Warmup request 1 finished and was excluded from the summary.
